26.02

The Potato Fields

Region: the Grey Mountains

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">Connects to: [25.04](/wiki/25-04/) and [26.01](/wiki/26-01/). </span>

Overview

The only thing that keeps the orcish warriors fed are the fields of potatoes that ring Hoth Achaar ([26.01](/wiki/26-01/)), which grow great yields even in the stony mountain soil (see [the significance of potatoes to the orcs](/wiki/orcs/)).
